recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed in core for FHIR-46649 unless the work group later changes the broader paging-link guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-46649 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core Search. It asked to clarify the trial-use sentence "Servers SHOULD NOT include content that is considered sensitive in the URLs." so it applies to paging links such as next/prev and explicitly excludes the self link.
initial_application: Commit 20dd71b98d7fbbc1b76799d43ffbfb7b7ddf7ed5 changed source/search.html to say "Servers SHOULD NOT include content that is considered sensitive in URLs, excluding the self link." The combined branch already contains that implementation commit.
additional_context: The relevant current source is source/search.html, the FHIR-core Search page containing the #paginglinks section. Zulip discussion in #implementers > Bundle Search Links records the reporter clarifying that the warning was meant for next/prev links, not the self link. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-08-19 record FHIR-46649 as Persuasive with a 7-0-0 vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already matches the Jira resolution and preserves the self-link exclusion in the authoritative search page. An empty audit commit was published for reconciliation tracking.

related_jiras.note: Surfaced in related Jira search because it also concerns Search self-link and paging-link conformance, but it addresses POST search support rather than the sensitive-content self-link exception.
